provenance.basis: Direct per-run measurement on the 33-run pre-threshold 8x16 raw product (runs 31-65, 1,096,728 events, SHA-256-verified against manifest_8x16.json) by two independent estimators: scripts/channel_polarity.py::infer_channel_polarity (locked module, isolated-dropout-masked) and an independent MAD-vote estimator (sigma = 1.4826*MAD of raw pretrigger samples, k=8 exclusive votes). Every channel unanimous across all 33 runs in both estimators.
provenance.note: Measured pattern is pair-alternating (+,-),(-,+),(-,+),(-,+): only pair (ch0,ch1) matches the v1 even-positive convention. Under v1 the B4/B6/B8 amplitudes in the 8x16 event product are noise-side maxima (e.g. ch4 median 14.5 ADC vs 2422.5 ADC true pulse height). Results consuming the v1 product (depth profile #1318, timing #1320) are FLAWED pending regeneration with this map. Odd channels 3/5/7 are the high-purity positive-going duplicate partners (frac_positive_preference >= 0.992).
